{{short description|German mathematician}}
[[File: Ina Kersten.jpg|thumb|Ina Kersten at the memorial colloquium for [[Ernst Witt]], Hamburg, 1991]]
'''Ina Kersten''' (born 1946){{r|born}} is a German mathematician and former president of the [[German Mathematical Society]]. Her research concerns [[abstract algebra]] including the theory of [[field extension]]s and [[algebraic group]]s.{{r|zeit}} She is a [[professor emerita]] at the [[University of Göttingen]].

Kersten was born in [[Hamburg]],{{r|zeit}} and earned her Ph.D. at the [[University of Hamburg]] in 1977. Her dissertation, ''p-Algebren über semilokalen Ringen'', was supervised by [[Ernst Witt]].{{r|mg}}
She completed a [[habilitation]] at the [[University of Regensburg]] in 1983.{{r|hab}}

Kersten was president of the German Mathematical Society from 1995 to 1997,{{r|zeit}} which meant she was the first woman to head the society.{{r|tjm}} Under her leadership, the society founded the journal ''Documenta Mathematica''.{{r|documenta}}
